elements.label: EXAMPLE 4.21
elements.title: Step-by-step example to illustrate hypothesis testing process

nodes: Problem statement: Drug under investigation for lung cancer, sample sizes and cancer-free counts for drug and placebo groups
Hypotheses: Null hypothesis H0: p1 ≤ p2; Alternative hypothesis Ha: p1 > p2 (claim)
Check requirements: samples random and independent; sample sizes large enough for normal approximation
Calculate weighted estimate p̄ = (x1 + x2) / (n1 + n2) = 383/480 = 0.798
Check four quantities ≥ 5: n1 p̄, n1 (1 - p̄), n2 p̄, n2 (1 - p̄)
connections: Check requirements leads to Calculate weighted estimate
Calculate weighted estimate leads to Check four quantities

elements.summary: This example walks through the hypothesis testing procedure for comparing two proportions, including stating hypotheses, checking requirements, and calculating the weighted estimate.
